root_cause: The five-area owner dashboard exposed only placeholders despite an independently validated canonical forecast endpoint; empty canonical results omitted the authenticated tenant identity. Client actions were not yet wired to the canonical decision API and required an idempotent human command / protected readback boundary.
prevention_rule: The authenticated /api/portal-forecasts handler returns server-resolved tenantId for OK and empty results; no browser-invented tenant or financial value is accepted. The owner dashboard only displays reviewed forecast records with scope, freshness, source, model, period, and independent review. APPROVE/REJECT issue fixed-key human commands via canonical /api/company-decision, enforce expected status, re-read Brain, and never infer provider execution. Block auto model activation and cross-tenant readback.
